footer.tagline: Elegant digital wedding invitations for every love story.

home.headline: One link.
home.description: A single, beautifully composed page for the day — schedule, registry, RSVP, dress code, directions — wrapped in your typography, sent in a sentence.

1.title: Choose your style
1.body: Pick from eighteen bespoke templates — botanical, modern, noir, heritage and more.

2.title: Add your details
2.body: Venue, schedule, dress code, personal message. Our AI writes it with you.

3.title: Share one link
3.body: Send via WhatsApp, email, or print a QR code. No app. No registration for guests.

4.title: Track RSVPs live
4.body: Watch responses roll in. Export your guest list as CSV at any time.

home.pricingDesc: Pay once, your invitation stays live for the full duration. No recurring charges, no surprises.

faqs.q1: Do guests need to download an app?
faqs.a1: No. Guests open a simple web link in any browser. No app, no account, no friction.
faqs.a2: Yes — just copy your unique link and send it however you like. WhatsApp, email, SMS, or print a QR code.
faqs.q3: Can I edit the invitation after publishing?
faqs.a3: Absolutely. You can update any detail — venue, time, personal message — at any time from your dashboard.
faqs.q4: How long does the invitation stay online?
faqs.a4: Essential stays active 6 months; Elegance and Signature stay active 12 months from the purchase date.
faqs.q5: Is there a limit on RSVP responses?
faqs.a5: No limit. As many guests as you invite can respond.

faqs.q1: How quickly does the invitation go live?
faqs.a1: Instantly — as soon as you complete the wizard and payment, your invitation is published and shareable immediately.
faqs.a2: Yes, a single payment covering the full active period. No subscriptions, no recurring fees, no hidden charges.
faqs.q3: Can I edit the invitation after publishing?
faqs.a3: Absolutely. All fields can be updated anytime from your dashboard — names, dates, venue, timeline, everything.
faqs.q4: Can I change the template after purchase?
faqs.a4: Signature plan includes a free template change. Essential and Elegance keep the template chosen at creation.
faqs.q5: What happens when the active period ends?
faqs.a5: The invitation page becomes inactive but all your data is retained. You can reactivate with a new plan at any time.
faqs.q6: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faqs.a6: Yes — contact us anytime before your wedding and we will credit the remaining period toward the upgrade.

privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1body: Invitia ("we", "us") operates an online platform for digital wedding invitations. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s2accountDesc: email address and password (hashed) when you register.
privacy.s2invitationDesc: names, wedding date, venue, photos, and other details you enter while creating your invitation.
privacy.s2rsvpDesc: names, attendance, menu preferences, and any optional fields filled in by your guests.
privacy.s2usageDesc: invitation view counts, browser type, and anonymised analytics.
privacy.s2paymentDesc: processed entirely by Stripe. We do not store card numbers.
s3list: To operate and deliver the invitation service
To send transactional emails (account confirmation, RSVP notifications)
To improve the platform through anonymised analytics
privacy.s4body: We process your data on the basis of contract performance (to provide the Service you purchased), legitimate interests (platform security, fraud prevention), and — where required — your explicit consent.
privacy.s5body: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with:
s5list: Supabase — database and authentication infrastructure (EU region)
privacy.s6body: Active invitation data is retained for the duration of your plan plus 12 months. After that, data is permanently deleted unless you request earlier deletion. Account data is retained until account deletion.
privacy.s7body: Under GDPR you have the right to:
privacy.s8body: We use only technically necessary cookies for authentication (session token). We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
privacy.s9body: Data is stored in Supabase with encryption at rest and in transit. Access to personal data is restricted to authorised personnel only.
privacy.s10body: For privacy enquiries or to exercise your rights, contact us at
privacy.s10body2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

terms.label: Legal
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1body: By accessing or using Invitia ("Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
terms.s2body: Invitia provides a platform for creating and publishing digital wedding invitations. Users can collect RSVPs, share event details, and manage guest communication through a personalised web page.
terms.s3body: You must provide accurate information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activity under your account.
terms.s4body: All payments are processed securely via Stripe. Prices are listed in euros (EUR) and are one-time fees that cover the stated active period. Due to the digital nature of the product, refunds are issued only where required by applicable law within 14 days of purchase, provided no invitation has been published (made publicly accessible).
terms.s5body: Your invitation remains publicly accessible for the duration of the plan you purchased (6 or 12 months from the date of activation). After expiry, the page becomes inaccessible but your data is retained for 12 months and can be reactivated.
terms.s6body: You retain ownership of all content you upload. By publishing an invitation, you grant Invitia a non-exclusive licence to display that content to guests accessing your invitation URL. You must not upload content that is unlawful, offensive, or infringes third-party rights.
terms.s7body: You may not use the Service for any purpose other than creating personal wedding invitations. Commercial reselling, automated scraping, or use of the Service to harm others is strictly prohibited.
terms.s8body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Invitia is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Service. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid for the relevant plan.
terms.s9body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. You may delete your account at any time from the dashboard settings.
terms.s10body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms. We will notify active users by email of material changes.
